features.text: ADJUSTABLE ROM CONTROL: Offers precise flexion and extension in 15° increments for guided rehabilitation.
THREE-POINT LEVERAGE PAD: Applies gentle, targeted pressure for progressive contracture correction.
STATIC-DYNAMIC THERAPY: Combines controlled positioning with dynamic stretch for balanced recovery.
EASY APPLICATION: Quick-release straps and simple hinge setup simplify daily use.
UNIVERSAL FIT: Works for either arm, supporting both post-surgery and post-injury therapy.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
